description: This Dart source file defines the ApiClient class responsible for communicating with a backend API. It includes methods to check backend availability, create, fetch, update, delete notes, and generate summaries, leveraging HTTP requests. The file imports dependencies for JSON handling, HTTP communication, environment variables, and a Note model.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Handles all API interactions for notes, including checking backend availability, CRUD operations, and summarization.

methods.name: isBackendAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the backend server is reachable and available.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with a title and content on the backend.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the backend.

methods.name: summarizeNote
methods.description: Requests the backend to generate a summary for a specific note.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note specified by its ID from the backend.
